confirmed: The source is Manuel Osvaldo Lebron Flores's Master of Human-Computer Interaction thesis, Carleton University, copyright 2026, with the recorded title and 105 PDF pages. Appendices A-G are included (PDF p. 1, title page; PDF p. 6, contents; PDF pp. 79-105, appendices).
The complete markdown was read, including references and Appendices A-G; the corrupted training-slide text was checked directly in the PDF (PDF pp. 83-88, Appendix C).

This is a laboratory within-person comparison of AI, Search Engine, and No Inspiration. The text says the condition order was fully counterbalanced and task-condition combinations varied, but does not state random allocation of orders; the appendices supply no randomization mechanism. Thus design_class=other, assignment.randomized=not_stated, criterion_1=unclear, and context_class=none are supported. has_randomized_people_study=false means no randomized people study is established by this source, not proof of nonrandom allocation (PDF p. 30, printed p. 22, section 3.4.1; PDF pp. 79-105, Appendices A-G, especially PDF p. 93, Appendix F section 3B).

The reported 26 participants are recruited people, not sketches, inspiration images, or ratings. Neither the randomized count nor the exact analyzed count for the sketch outcomes is explicitly reported; retaining null is appropriate. With only 26 recruits, the study is below the 50-person requirement and core=no is supported (PDF p. 27, printed p. 19, section 3.1; PDF pp. 45-47, printed pp. 37-39, sections 3.5 and 4.1.1-4.1.2).
The ethics protocol planned a maximum of 40 participants; this is not the achieved recruitment or analysis count (PDF p. 94, Appendix F section 4B, protocol p. 4/12).

Participants were adults recruited through campus posters, with no required design experience; the source does not establish that the entire sample consisted of students (PDF pp. 27-28, printed pp. 19-20, section 3.1 and Table 3.1).

Participants used Gemini to generate their own inspiration, Google search in Microsoft Edge, or no external support. Tasks were paper sketches for mall, education, and travel websites; only final sketches were considered. Tasks had no time limit and the session took approximately 60 minutes (PDF pp. 29-31, printed pp. 21-23, sections 3.3-3.4.1 and Table 3.2; PDF p. 45, printed p. 37, section 3.5).

Originality is a per-sketch rarity score derived from a blinded external design expert's clustering, performed separately for each website task. The novelty/category_count coding and output-scored eligibility are supported (PDF pp. 33-34, printed pp. 25-26, section 3.4.2, Originality).

Design fixation divides copied features by all features in the participant's own sketch; each sketch is compared with that participant's viewed inspiration samples. Research-team ratings were reconciled and averaged per participant. This is copying from inspiration, not diversity across different people's outputs (PDF p. 35, printed p. 27, and PDF p. 40, printed p. 32, section 3.4.2, Measuring Design Fixation).

Originality statistics match exactly: AI M = 80.32% (SD = 11.37%); Search Engine M = 81.50% (SD = 10.26%); No Inspiration M = 83.13% (SD = 9.04%); omnibus Friedman χ²(2) = 0.804, W = 0.015, p = 0.669. No pairwise originality test is reported (PDF p. 46, printed p. 38, section 4.1.1).

Design-fixation statistics match exactly: AI M = 52.85% (SD = 31.64%); Search Engine M = 23.98% (SD = 22.57%); Wilcoxon signed-ranks Z = -3.19, p = 0.001, with higher fixation in the AI condition. The one-line finding preserves this result and the nonsignificant omnibus originality result (PDF pp. 46-47, printed pp. 38-39, sections 4.1.1-4.1.2 and Figure 4.1).

This is an empirical thesis rather than a synthesis; no pooled estimates or synthesis study counts require extraction (PDF pp. 27-55, Chapters 3-4). No company involvement is reported; the protocol identifies faculty-supervisor startup funds and no conflicts (PDF pp. 92-93, Appendix F sections 2D-2G).
summary: The full thesis supports the form's design and eligibility decisions: randomization is not stated, and 26 recruited people fall below the 50-person threshold while the exact analyzed sketch sample remains unreported. All recorded originality and design-fixation statistics and the one-line finding match the PDF.
